en.title: Native view text and input
en.body: Align single-line UI text to backing pixels without changing layout. Read a current text revision’s readiness and select its typeface. Pointer activations expose their actual stage and local coordinates and optional propagation control; declarative views can specify accessible names, decorative subtrees, actionable panels and clipped bounds.

zh.title: 原生视图文字与输入
zh.body: 将单行 UI 文字对齐实际像素而不改变布局；读取当前文字版本的就绪状态并选择字体。指针激活提供真实 Stage 与局部坐标，以及可选的冒泡控制；声明式视图可指定无障碍名称、装饰子树、可操作面板与裁剪后的边界。
